note: Driver-INDEPENDENT template. The engine's build-catalog action resolves each csnName + value label to the concrete SettingID/code from -createCSN on the user's actual driver, producing data/nvidia-settings.json. 'auto-cap' is replaced with (refresh - 4) FPS for the user's display.

power-mgmt.why: Keeps the GPU at full clocks so frametimes don't wobble when the CPU briefly stalls. Consistency, not raw FPS.

vsync-off.why: Absolute-minimum input lag for the Esports profile; accepts screen tearing.

vsync-on.why: Tear-free with the lowest latency ONLY when paired with G-SYNC + a sub-refresh cap. Gated on VRR detection.

ull-off.why: Left Off: in-game NVIDIA Reflex does this better, and Ultra can hurt on a CPU-bound rig.

pref-refresh.why: Insurance so your high-refresh panel is never stuck at a lower refresh.

fps-cap.why: Caps a few FPS below your refresh so G-SYNC stays engaged and never hits the V-Sync latency wall.

bg-cap.why: Throttles alt-tabbed games to save power/heat; no effect on the focused game.

shader-size.why: A bigger shader cache means fewer first-run shader-compile stutters. Anti-stutter hygiene, not an FPS gain.

shader-enabled.why: Confirms the shader disk cache is on.

gsync-global.why: Enables G-SYNC globally (only offered if a VRR display is detected).

gsync-mode.why: Lets G-SYNC work in borderless/windowed too.

esports.name: Esports / Lowest Latency
esports.description: Tear-tolerant, absolute-minimum input lag (the config many CS2/Valorant pros run). Average FPS unchanged.

balanced.name: Balanced (Recommended)
balanced.description: Tear-free and within ~1ms of the latency floor. Requires a G-SYNC/VRR display; falls back to the Esports sync model if none is detected.

quality.name: Quality
quality.description: For heavier titles (Squad/PUBG/Apex high) when GPU-bound. Behaves like Balanced on 1080p shooters; touches no image-quality knobs.

placebo.why: Modern GPUs lose ~0 FPS from full-quality filtering; degrading it just makes textures shimmer. Leave at Quality.
POTENTIALLY HARMFUL on a hybrid P+E CPU — forcing single-threaded driver work removes free parallelism. Leave Auto.
A memory-overclock-headroom tweak with no gaming FPS effect. Leave default.
Sharpening textures below the game's own minimum is the one genuine unfair-advantage flag anti-cheat may scrutinize. FrameForge never ships this.
Image-quality micro-tweak with no measurable competitive FPS benefit.

inGame.name: NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency = On
inGame.games: CS2, Valorant, Apex, Fortnite, PUBG, Dota, DBD, League
inGame.note: The single biggest real latency win (~20-40ms). Use On+Boost only if you ever drop GPU-bound. Squad has no Reflex - the frame cap covers it.

inGame.name: Reflex 2 / Frame Warp = On
inGame.note: Further latency cut on Blackwell; minor edge-warp on very fast flicks.

inGame.name: DLSS Multi-Frame Generation = OFF
inGame.note: MFG raises the FPS number but ADDS input latency - the opposite of what you want competitively.
